snippet.title: EarthBound Collection "Commercial" Trailer [VHS Rip, 1996]
snippet.description:
https://ebbr.neocities.org/
Voice over by @RemieRetro 
Thumbnail by @MP64-o4i  (https://mp32.newgrounds.com)
Box art by @BigSharkZ 
Editing by @livvy94 

In another reality... EarthBound was just as popular as other Nintendo franchises and an official re-release came out in 1996, in an extra-big two-game box set. This is a trailer from that alternate reality, recorded on a real VHS tape!
